title: The US criticizes Australia's digital duty-of-care proposal, which has a provision that would require social media platforms to let users opt out of algorithms (Angus Whitley/Bloomberg)
summary: Angus Whitley / Bloomberg: The US criticizes Australia's digital duty-of-care proposal, which has a provision that would require social media platforms to let users opt out of algorithms — The US government criticized Australia's plan to clamp down on social media algorithms and harmful content online …
